us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: FAA says US air travel should normalize after nationwide ground stop
bullets: Nationwide disruption followed overloaded air-traffic communications and radar systems.
Officials said schedules should recover by late Sunday.
Thousands of Saturday cancellations continued after Friday’s four-hour stop.

articles.title: Officials blame router and legacy systems for air-traffic outage
bullets: A contractor was replacing copper wiring with fiber-optic equipment.
Officials said a router flooded the network with connection requests.
Transportation leaders urged Congress to fund air-traffic modernization.

articles.title: Federal judge pauses Trump plan for Washington public golf course redevelopment
bullets: The order delays work at East Potomac Golf Links for two weeks.
Trump wanted the site closed November 15 for renovation.
The court order runs through November 28 unless changed.

articles.title: Trump heads to Asia seeking momentum after midterm setbacks
bullets: Trump plans meetings during a major Asia trip this week.
AP reports a possible three-way meeting with Xi and Putin.
The trip follows Republican losses in the midterm elections.

articles.title: FAA outage, Microsoft disruption and AI turmoil raise infrastructure concerns
bullets: AP examined several technology disruptions hitting Americans in recent days.
The FAA outage disrupted flights nationwide.
Microsoft services and AI-sector instability added to public concern.

articles.title: ASEAN summit opens in Manila with conflicts and security on agenda
bullets: Southeast Asian leaders began three days of talks in Manila.
Disputes, economic uncertainty and transnational threats topped the agenda.
Trump is expected to join dialogues during his Asia trip.

articles.title: Middle East updates: Israel kills Hamas commander; Jordan sentences church-attack defendants
bullets: AP reported multiple major developments across the region.
Israel said it killed a senior Hamas commander.
Jordan sentenced three people over a church attack.

articles.title: Iran war and energy shock concerns ripple through markets and diplomacy
bullets: US officials debated inflation pressures tied to energy supplies.
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged the Fed not to hike rates.
Federal Reserve officials said price pressures extended beyond oil.

articles.title: Chinese purchases of US farm goods lag despite trade agreement
bullets: Reuters analysis found non-soybean farm purchases on pace for a seven-year low.
The deal calls for $17 billion in annual purchases through 2028.
The shortfall highlights uncertainty around US-China trade commitments.

articles.title: Cape Verde holds presidential election
bullets: Cape Verdeans voted in a presidential election on November 15.
The election was listed among the day’s major global events.
Results were not yet reported in the indexed summary.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Foreign investors pump ₹84,290 crore into Indian equities in November first half
bullets: PTI reported strong foreign inflows into Indian equities.
The figure covers the first half of November.
The story was listed among India’s top items at 5 pm.

articles.title: India’s health spending triples as out-of-pocket share falls
bullets: National Health Accounts data showed health spending at ₹4.14 lakh crore.
Out-of-pocket spending fell to 42.7%.
PTI listed the figures among Sunday’s top India stories.

articles.title: Pune election officials file complaint over attempted voter shift
bullets: Officials alleged an attempt to shift 40 voters.
The development appeared in India live updates on November 15.
The story involved local election-administration concerns in Pune.

articles.title: Congress MLA accused of vandalising stage at Uttarakhand event
bullets: Harish Dhami and supporters allegedly vandalised a fair inauguration stage.
Dhami said he was not allowed to speak at the event.
The incident occurred in Pithoragarh district near the Indo-Nepal border.

articles.title: India reaches SAFF Championship final after narrow win over Bhutan
bullets: India beat Bhutan 2-1 in the SAFF Championship semifinals.
The Blue Tigers advanced to the final.
News On AIR reported the result late November 14.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: US market movers and market-moving stock stories

articles.title: Nasdaq falls Friday as Nvidia fallout weighs on technology shares
bullets: The Nasdaq Composite ended lower Friday.
Technology stocks were the biggest drag on the market.
Nvidia declined after Jensen Huang’s resignation shook the AI sector.

articles.title: Nvidia volatility dominates AI and semiconductor trading
bullets: Nvidia’s market value has fallen sharply from its October high.
AI-linked stocks sold off as investors reassessed leadership risk.
Reuters-linked reports cited wider concern across chip and AI names.

articles.title: Applied Materials flagged as notable earnings-driven mover
bullets: Applied Materials was highlighted among significant story stocks.
The move was tied to earnings and semiconductor-sector sentiment.
The stock appeared in market summaries after Friday trading.

articles.title: Liftoff Mobile highlighted as notable positive market mover
bullets: Liftoff Mobile was listed among notable positive movers.
The move came during a volatile tech-heavy trading session.
Market coverage grouped it with Friday’s top stock spotlights.

articles.title: Hancock Whitney to buy Trustmark in $3.2 billion stock deal
bullets: Hancock Whitney agreed to acquire Trustmark.
The transaction is valued at $3.2 billion in stock.
The regional-bank deal was reported in Friday’s deal flow.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate and economic stories moving markets

articles.title: Modine draws attention amid data-center cooling deal reports
bullets: Modine makes cooling systems used in data centers.
The company had a market capitalization near $5.6 billion.
Reports placed it among notable AI-infrastructure deal targets.

articles.title: Microsoft services recover after major Outlook and Teams outage
bullets: Outlook, Teams and other Microsoft 365 services were disrupted globally.
Microsoft said service levels were returning toward normal.
The company said there was no indication of a cyberattack.

articles.title: SpaceX recovers Starship upper stage with launch-tower arms
bullets: SpaceX completed a 22-hour orbital test flight.
The Starship vehicle was recovered at Starbase, Texas.
The catch marked a first for an orbital upper-stage spacecraft.

articles.title: Ferguson Enterprises rises after guidance boost
bullets: Ferguson shares rose 11.2% on Monday.
The company raised full-year guidance after quarterly results.
Non-residential sales grew 15%, supporting capital-goods sentiment.
articles.source: Activest Wealth Management weekly market report

articles.title: Moderna falls after unclear 2027 cost outlook
bullets: Moderna lost 12.2% for the week.
Investors reacted to a 2027 cost outlook.
The report said revenue visibility remained unclear.
articles.source: Activest Wealth Management weekly market report

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns, sending shockwaves through AI industry
bullets: Huang’s resignation unsettled Nvidia and AI-linked companies.
Rivals including AMD and Intel could seek advantage.
AP said the fallout may cool AI-boom exuberance.

articles.title: Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Outlook, Teams, Copilot and Exchange Online
bullets: The outage began Thursday and affected users in many countries.
Reports showed high Downdetector complaint volumes.
Microsoft said services were returning to normal levels.

articles.title: Microsoft lobbies against potential Chinese optical-gear import ban
bullets: The FCC is considering restrictions on Chinese optical transceivers.
Microsoft and industry groups warned a ban could slow data-center rollout.
The issue affects AI data-center networking supply chains.

articles.title: Restricted Nvidia chips reported in Chinese AI computing projects
bullets: A Reuters review identified Chinese AI projects using restricted Nvidia processors.
The projects reportedly totaled more than $3 billion.
Nvidia says US export controls shut it out of China’s AI data-center market.

articles.title: AI economy’s dense corporate ties draw scrutiny after Nvidia turmoil
bullets: Axios highlighted overlapping Nvidia, Microsoft and Anthropic relationships.
The report described a concentrated web of AI financing and cloud deals.
The scrutiny followed turmoil around Nvidia leadership.
